text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 antibodies are developed by the body in response to infection or vaccination, indicating prior exposure to the SARS-CoV-2 virus. These antibodies can be detected through antibody tests, which help identify individuals who may have been infected or recovered from COVID-19. However, antibody tests are not suitable for detecting active infections. Research suggests that autoimmunity, where the immune system mistakenly attacks the body, may play a role in Long COVID symptoms, and antibodies from Long COVID patients are being studied to understand this phenomenon, according to Yale Medicine.
